title: Gr33n's Economy 2
description: A Remake of Gr33n's Economy(AKA Gr33n's Coin collection)
body:
Gr33n's Economy 2! for 1.21.4 neoforge 

Reworked entirely! using new villager Banker!

4 Coins! Copper, Iron, Gold and Netherite!

villagers will have new trades that use coins mixed in with thier old emerald based trades!

Coins will eventully work with a new block! the coin Accpeter! for all your Vending mechine dreams!
